definitions.gloss: stinting; holding back; being stingy with
definitions.explanation: Reluctantly giving or using something, or withholding what one has. Can refer to being stingy with money, information, effort, or resources.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}を{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみしないでほしい。
{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみせずに{全力|ぜんりょく}で{取|と}り{組|く}もう。
examples.english: Let's give it our all without holding back.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{知識|ちしき}の{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみをせず、{何|なん}でも{教|おし}えてくれる。
examples.english: He doesn't hold back on his knowledge and teaches us anything.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the negative ({出|だ}し{惜|お}しみしない) to praise someone for being generous with their time, knowledge, or resources. Can also be used critically when someone is being stingy. A compound of {出|だ}す (to put out) and {惜|お}しむ (to grudge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|だ}し{惜|お}しみしない (to not hold back)
- {出|だ}し{惜|お}しみする (to be stingy with)
- {情報|じょうほう}の{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ (withholding information)
